description: This file contains LESS mixins and utility classes related to icon styling and accessibility helpers for screen readers.

methods.name: fa-icon
methods.description: Mixin for styling font awesome icons with smoothing and font styles.

methods.name: fa-icon-rotate
methods.description: Mixin for rotating icons by a specified degree and rotation.

methods.name: fa-icon-flip
methods.description: Mixin for flipping icons horizontally or vertically with optional rotation.

methods.name: sr-only
methods.description: Utility class to visually hide content but keep it accessible for screen readers.

methods.name: sr-only-focusable
methods.description: Utility class to show hidden content only when focused or active, for accessibility.
